Every CDP harness must use the settle() helper from checks/lib/exit.mjs, not only the three named ones: updateui.check.mjs:75, visibility:105, office:335, lanes:334, hover:139 and every other checks/*.check.mjs that still ends with cleanup(); process.exit() or process.exit(n) after Chrome/dash/WebSocket work. Grep for process.exit in checks/ and convert each harness that starts Chrome or ca dash. The runner now counts a crash after PASS lines as a failed check, so a leftover one would fail good lanes.
2. settle() must also run on an uncaught exception or unhandled rejection (keep a process.on('exit') or uncaughtException hook that kills Chrome and the dash), so a crash never orphans them (glanceoffice.check.mjs:23 lost this).
3. Kill and await children before deleting temp dirs (bucket.check.mjs:105), and treat an EBUSY/EPERM on the temp-dir cleanup as a warning, not a failure.
Run each converted check once in the foreground with a timeout to confirm exit 0 and no Assertion failed line.
